whatIs: CodeFronts is a site of copy-and-paste CSS and Tailwind components, with about 5,000 examples across more than 200 collections: interfaces, motion effects, layouts, and navigation menus. It adds CSS generators and tools such as a CSS-to-Tailwind converter.
It's a good fit when you're looking for a specific piece to use as a starting point, without installing a library.
uses: Copying a hover effect or an animation for a landing page.
Generating a gradient or a shadow with the generators and bringing the CSS into your project.
Converting existing CSS styles to Tailwind classes.
caveats: These are standalone examples you have to adapt and test; there's no versioned package that updates on its own.
Style and quality vary between collections, so check accessibility and responsiveness before using them.
The site shows ads for an external course, with an affiliate link.
pricingNote: Site and tools are free, under the MIT license, with no sign-up or paywall.
idealFor: Anyone looking for CSS or Tailwind snippets to copy and adapt.
